title: Open each role to see its support path
prompt: Select a role to reveal what it can do in the Support Center.

hotspots.label: Designated Support Contact
hotspots.detail: Ticket creation is available to Designated Support Contacts as defined in the Glean Support Agreement. To be set up as one, contact the Glean account team. To create a ticket, open the support widget, select Create a ticket, describe the issue, select a priority, and submit.

hotspots.label: Any other signed-in user
hotspots.detail: Conversations are open to all users. Open the support widget and select Send us a message. The assistant triages the request. If it cannot resolve the issue, it guides you toward a ticket. You can also ask your Glean administrator to submit a ticket.

hotspots.label: A user with evidence to share
hotspots.detail: Users who are not entitled to tickets can be cc'd on a conversation or ticket with a Designated Support Contact. Use this when an end user must supply screenshots or reproduction steps.

hotspots.label: Email to help@glean.com
hotspots.detail: Email reaches Glean Support too. The AI assistant triages first and hands off to a human agent for Designated Support Contacts. Email is not the SLA-tracked path; the next screens explain why.
